'''Alexander Razgulin''' ({{langx|ru|Алекса́ндр Вита́льевич Разгу́лин}}) (born 1963) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[https://en.cs.msu.ru/persons/233 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Stable method for solving linear equations with noncompact operators and its applications to control and observation problems» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2009).

Author of 24 books and more than 100 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/razgulin/ Scientific works of Alexander Razgulin]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=39588&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Alexander Razgulin]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
